items.description: Printr provided a fully featured 3D printing api that allows developers to create and connect all types of applications to 3D printing and directly to 3D printers.
Lets people reprint public domain books from Internet Archive and Google Books.

This web application allows you to enter a keyword or hashtag, and the finds the people on Twitter who are the most influential when it comes to tweeting about that subject. Influence is based on retweets. You then have the option to follow that person or retweet what the person followed. You can also send a tweet to the author. This is a great app for determining who the trendsetters are on social media.
ZMS is a free SMS gateway with a retro 8BIT user interface. ZMS enables any iOS device to send and receive free SMS text messages to any cell phone.
Apartment finding service for Chicago, The Homestead Group. Uses the Peekacity API.
MapDays allows users to refine event searching by location and time.

School Performance Maps provides a bird's eye view of public school performance in California. Data from California Department of Education, Academic Performance Index. The 1-10 is statewide rank school, low to high.
Find a business broker visually using Google Maps.
A resource for california parents and home buyers to explore the performance of their local school. Displays schools color coded by their rank and API scores.

Our powerful, easy-to-use background check search tools and technology enable fast access to comprehensive background check data with a range of search solutions that meet your varying needs. The ProntoScreen instant background check searched our proprietary criminal records database as well as other public sources like court records, incarceration records, prison records, probation & parole release information & more!
SnapWidget allows you to display your Instagram photos on your website or blog using an easily customizable and embeddable widget.

WhatWine is a mobile application that acts as a personal sommelier to those that love to pair wine with their meal. This application helps customers to quickly choose an appropriate type of wine to pair with their meal, turning even the layman into a wine expert.
Uses Yahoo! Query Language, the Twitter API, and HTML5 Canvas to generate interesting art from tiny Twitter avatars.from
German-Korean Dictionary is a translation site that uses the Forvo API to help with pronunciation.
Shows exponentially smoothed flu trends in Sweden based on self-reported health in Twitter messages.
We all have people in our lives we'd like to talk to more often. Stay In Touch is a simple app that helps you prioritize and stay connected to the family and friends you care about.
Sets up alerts when invoices are late and calls someone to ask them where your money is. Plays clips of Stewie Griffin (from the TV series, Family Guy) at various late payment points.

A real estate site that gives you quick and easy access to information on any property in the US. eppraisal.com data is updated daily and pulls from a database of about 70 million homes. Integrated maps and estimated home valuations.

View tweets on Google Earth. This Google Earth plug-in allows you to navigate and explore geographic data on a 3D globe using a web browser. The plug-in is also used on Earth view in Google Maps. If you want to embed the Google Earth plug-in on your website, visit the Google Earth API site to learn more.
A nice little game using Google Maps to test your knowledge of geography (mainly in Germany and Europe).
Designer dining room furniture site. Uses the Shopping.com API. Also, includes modern and contemporary Italian dining room furniture and dining decor.
Google Maps can easily be customized to display searchable floor plans. A floor plan drawing in PDF, JPG, GIS, CAD formats, can be displayed on the map as seen in this example.
